subject: general
question: “Radcliffe line” separate India with which country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pakistan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Radcliffe Line** served as the dividing line between **British India's Punjab Province and Bengal Presidency in India and Pakistan.**
 
• It was named after** Cyril Radcliffe**, who had the final responsibility for dividing** 175,000 square miles (450,000 km2)** of land with **88 million **inhabitants as the joint head of the two border commissioners for the two provinces.
 
• Following the partition of **British** **India** on **August 17, 1947,** the demarcation line was made public.
 
• Nowadays, the line's western side forms part of the border between** India and Pakistan,** while the eastern side forms the border between **Bangladesh and India**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
